items.definition: Bilimsel bilginin pratik sorunları çözmek veya yeni araçlar geliştirmek için uygulanmasıyla ortaya çıkan alet, yöntem ve sistemlerin bütünü.
exampleSentences: New technology has transformed the way people communicate with one another.
The company invests heavily in technology to stay ahead of its competitors.
Many jobs today require at least a basic understanding of modern technology.

items.definition: Belirli bir işi yapmak üzere tasarlanmış, genellikle elektronik veya mekanik bir alet.
exampleSentences: The hospital uses a small device to monitor patients' heart rates continuously.
She charged her device overnight so it would be ready for the meeting.
Engineers are designing a device that can detect gas leaks automatically.

items.definition: Birbirine bağlı bilgisayarların, kişilerin veya sistemlerin bilgi ya da kaynak paylaşımı için oluşturduğu yapı.
exampleSentences: The university's computer network crashed during the exam period.
She built a wide network of contacts while working in the industry.
Data travels across the network almost instantly once the connection is established.

items.definition: Bir bilgisayarın veya cihazın çalışmasını sağlayan program ve verilerin tümü.
exampleSentences: The company released new software to fix the security flaws in its system.
Engineers spent months developing software that could analyse the data automatically.
Outdated software often makes a computer more vulnerable to attacks.

items.definition: Dünya çapındaki bilgisayarları birbirine bağlayan ve bilgi paylaşımını sağlayan küresel ağ.
exampleSentences: Access to the internet has changed how students research their assignments.
The village finally got a reliable internet connection last year.
Many businesses now depend entirely on the internet to reach their customers.

items.definition: Bilginin elektronik ortamda sayısal kodlar biçiminde işlendiği veya saklandığı.
exampleSentences: The library has converted most of its archive into digital format.
Digital technology has made it easier to share information instantly.
The newspaper shifted from print to a fully digital edition.

items.definition: İnternet üzerinden bağlantılı veya erişilebilir olan.
exampleSentences: More students are choosing to complete their degrees online.
The course materials are all available online for registered users.
She spends several hours online researching before making a purchase.

items.definition: Belirli görevleri insan müdahalesi olmadan veya sınırlı müdahaleyle yerine getirebilen programlanabilir makine.
exampleSentences: The factory installed a robot to handle the most repetitive tasks.
Researchers are teaching the robot to recognise different objects on its own.
A small robot now delivers meals directly to hospital patients.

items.definition: Görüntü veya bilginin gösterildiği düz, genellikle elektronik yüzey.
exampleSentences: The screen went black just as the presentation was about to begin.
Reading from a screen for too long can strain your eyes.
The new phone has a much larger screen than the previous model.

items.definition: Daha önce var olmayan bir şeyi ilk kez tasarlayıp ortaya çıkarmak.
exampleSentences: The engineer invented a device that could purify water without electricity.
Nobody knows exactly who invented the first practical light bulb.
Students were encouraged to invent their own simple machines for the project.

items.definition: Yeni bir fikir, yöntem veya ürünün geliştirilip uygulamaya konulması.
exampleSentences: The award recognises innovation in renewable energy design.
Constant innovation has kept the company competitive in a crowded market.
Her team is responsible for driving innovation across all our products.

items.definition: Bir işlemi insan müdahalesi olmadan makine veya yazılım aracılığıyla gerçekleştirmek.
exampleSentences: The factory decided to automate its packaging line to cut costs.
Many routine office tasks can now be automated with simple software.
The system automates the process of sorting customer complaints by topic.

items.definition: Bir problemi çözmek için izlenen, adım adım tanımlanmış işlem kuralları dizisi.
exampleSentences: The search engine's algorithm ranks pages according to hundreds of factors.
Researchers designed a new algorithm to detect fraud more accurately.
The app's recommendation algorithm learns from what you watch and click.

items.definition: Bilgisayarda düzenli biçimde saklanan ve kolayca erişilip güncellenebilen veri topluluğu.
exampleSentences: The company keeps all customer records in a single central database.
Researchers searched the database for studies published in the last decade.
The new system will make it easier to update the database in real time.

items.definition: Bilgiyi yetkisiz kişiler tarafından okunamayacak şekilde şifreleyerek koruma yöntemi.
exampleSentences: The bank uses strong encryption to protect its customers' financial data.
Without encryption, messages sent over public networks can easily be intercepted.
The app added end-to-end encryption after users raised privacy concerns.

items.definition: Yazılım uygulamalarının üzerinde çalıştığı veya kullanıcıların bir hizmete eriştiği temel sistem ya da ortam.
exampleSentences: The company built its own platform to host and sell online courses.
Developers can create new applications for the platform using a public toolkit.
The video-sharing platform now reaches millions of users worldwide.

items.definition: Bir kullanıcının bir sistemle etkileşime girmesini sağlayan ekran, düğme veya komutlar bütünü.
exampleSentences: The new interface is much simpler than the version it replaced.
Designers tested several interfaces before choosing the most intuitive one.
A clear interface helps users find what they need without confusion.

items.definition: Fiziksel olarak var olmayan ancak bilgisayar teknolojisi aracılığıyla gerçekmiş gibi deneyimlenen.
exampleSentences: Students attended a virtual tour of the museum from their classroom.
The company held its annual conference in a virtual format this year.
Virtual reality allows users to explore places they could never visit in person.

items.definition: Kablo kullanmadan radyo dalgalarıyla veri ileten veya bağlantı kuran.
exampleSentences: The office switched entirely to wireless internet last spring.
Wireless headphones have become far more common than wired ones.
The printer needs no cables because it uses a wireless link to the laptop.

items.definition: Bir ürünün seri üretime geçmeden önce test edilmek üzere yapılan ilk örneği.
exampleSentences: Engineers built a working prototype before seeking investment for the product.
The first prototype failed several safety tests and had to be redesigned.
It took the team almost a year to turn the idea into a working prototype.

items.definition: Bir ağın belirli bir sürede taşıyabildiği veri miktarını ifade eden kapasite ölçüsü.
exampleSentences: The office needed more bandwidth to support video calls for every employee.
Streaming high-definition video consumes a large amount of bandwidth.
The provider promised extra bandwidth during peak evening hours.

items.definition: Elektrik akımının belirli bir yol boyunca aktığı, birbirine bağlı elemanlardan oluşan sistem.
exampleSentences: A short circuit caused the machine to shut down suddenly.
Engineers designed a smaller circuit to fit inside the compact device.
The technician traced the fault back to a single damaged circuit.

items.definition: Bir bilgisayar veya elektronik sistemin fiziksel parçalarının tümü.
exampleSentences: The laptop's hardware could not support the demands of the new software.
The company upgraded its hardware to speed up processing times.
A faulty piece of hardware was responsible for the repeated crashes.

items.definition: Bir sistemi veya cihazı daha gelişmiş, daha yeni bir sürümüyle değiştirmek.
exampleSentences: The company decided to upgrade its servers to handle the extra traffic.
Customers who upgrade to the latest model receive a discount on trade-in.
The free upgrade added several new features to the existing software.

items.definition: Başka bir sistem, cihaz veya programla birlikte sorunsuz çalışabilen.
exampleSentences: The new printer is compatible with almost every operating system.
Make sure the charger is compatible with your phone before you buy it.
Older files are not always compatible with the latest version of the software.

items.definition: Daha yeni ve gelişmiş bir alternatif ortaya çıktığı için artık kullanılmayan veya kullanılmaması gereken.
exampleSentences: The rapid pace of innovation makes some devices obsolete within a few years.
The factory replaced its obsolete machinery with automated equipment.
Many skills once considered essential have become obsolete in the digital age.

items.definition: Farklı parçaları veya sistemleri birbiriyle uyumlu, tek bir bütün hâline getirmek.
exampleSentences: The company plans to integrate the two software platforms into one system.
New employees are given training to help them integrate into the team.
The device integrates several functions that once required separate tools.

items.definition: Gerçek bir durumu veya süreci, bilgisayar ya da model aracılığıyla taklit ederek incelemek.
exampleSentences: Engineers used software to simulate how the bridge would react to strong winds.
The training programme simulates emergency situations so pilots can practise safely.
Scientists ran the model several times to simulate different climate scenarios.

items.definition: Çevresindeki fiziksel değişiklikleri (ışık, ısı, hareket gibi) algılayıp bunları sinyale dönüştüren cihaz.
exampleSentences: A motion sensor turns the lights on automatically when someone enters the room.
The car's sensors detect obstacles and warn the driver in time.
Engineers placed sensors throughout the bridge to monitor its structural condition.

items.definition: Parmak izi, yüz veya ses gibi kişiye özgü fiziksel özelliklere dayanarak kimlik doğrulayan.
exampleSentences: The airport introduced biometric checks to speed up passport control.
Many phones now unlock using biometric data such as a fingerprint.
The company installed biometric scanners at the entrance for extra security.

items.definition: Var olan bir düzeni veya işleyişi köklü biçimde değiştirip bozmak.
exampleSentences: The new app has disrupted the entire taxi industry within a few years.
A power failure disrupted production at the factory for several hours.
Streaming services have disrupted the way people watch television.

items.definition: Talep arttıkça büyüklüğü veya kapasitesi kolayca artırılabilen.
exampleSentences: The start-up needed a more scalable system to handle its growing user base.
Cloud computing makes it easier to build scalable applications.
Investors were impressed by how scalable the company's business model was.

items.definition: Bir şirkete veya kişiye ait olan, izinsiz kullanılamayan (yazılım, teknoloji vb. için).
exampleSentences: The device runs on proprietary software that only the manufacturer can update.
Competitors cannot copy the design because it relies on proprietary technology.
The company keeps its manufacturing process proprietary to protect its advantage.

items.definition: Bir buluşun sahibine belirli bir süre boyunca onu ticari olarak kullanma hakkını veren resmi belge.
exampleSentences: The inventor filed a patent to protect her new design.
The company holds several patents for its battery technology.
It can take years for a patent application to be approved.

items.definition: Bir ürünü, yazılımı veya hakkı belirli koşullar altında kullanma iznini gösteren resmi belge.
exampleSentences: The company purchased a licence to use the software across all its offices.
Without a valid licence, distributing the film would be illegal.
The university holds a licence that allows students to access the journal database.

items.definition: Bir alanda uzun süredir aranan çözüme ulaşılmasını sağlayan önemli buluş veya gelişme.
exampleSentences: Scientists announced a major breakthrough in battery storage technology.
The breakthrough came after years of failed experiments.
Researchers hope the discovery will lead to a breakthrough in treating the disease.

items.definition: Bir alanda ilk kez yeni bir yöntem veya fikir geliştirip yolu açan kişi ya da kuruluş.
exampleSentences: She is widely regarded as a pioneer in the field of artificial intelligence.
The company pioneered a new method of recycling electronic waste.
Early pioneers of the internet could not have predicted how it would grow.

items.definition: Bir şirketin belirli bir işi kendi bünyesi yerine dış bir firmaya yaptırması.
exampleSentences: The firm decided to outsource its customer service to another country.
Many companies outsource software development to reduce costs.
Outsourcing production overseas raised concerns among local workers.

items.definition: Bir süreci daha basit, hızlı ve verimli hâle getirmek.
exampleSentences: The new software streamlined the entire ordering process.
Management is looking for ways to streamline communication between departments.
Streamlining the approval process cut the waiting time in half.

items.definition: Bir şeyi küçük değişikliklerle daha iyi, daha kusursuz hâle getirmek.
exampleSentences: The team refined the algorithm after testing it on real user data.
She refined her presentation several times before the final version.
The design was refined based on feedback from early users.

items.definition: Hemen her yerde bulunan veya karşılaşılan, yaygın biçimde var olan.
exampleSentences: Smartphones have become almost ubiquitous in daily life.
Sensors are now ubiquitous in modern manufacturing plants.
Wireless internet is so ubiquitous that many people forget life without it.

items.definition: Artık gerekli olmayan ya da işlevini yitirmiş; bir çalışan için, işi ortadan kalktığı için işten çıkarılmış.
exampleSentences: The upgrade made several older components redundant.
Hundreds of workers were made redundant when the factory closed.
Engineers removed the redundant code to simplify the programme.

items.definition: Fazla açıklama gerektirmeden, doğal bir biçimde kolayca anlaşılıp kullanılabilen.
exampleSentences: The app's design is so intuitive that new users need almost no instructions.
Designers aimed for an intuitive interface that anyone could navigate.
A more intuitive layout would reduce the number of support calls.

items.definition: Dışarıdan yönlendirilmeden kendi kararlarını alarak işleyebilen.
exampleSentences: The company is testing autonomous vehicles on quiet suburban roads.
The rover is autonomous enough to choose its own route across rough terrain.
Autonomous drones are increasingly used to inspect remote infrastructure.

items.definition: Bir cihaz veya sistemin normal şekilde çalışmayı durdurması ya da hatalı çalışması.
exampleSentences: The plane returned to the airport after a sensor malfunctioned mid-flight.
A software malfunction delayed the launch by several hours.
Technicians were called in to fix the malfunctioning equipment.

items.definition: Farklı teknolojilerin, fikirlerin veya eğilimlerin zamanla birleşip benzer bir noktaya doğru ilerlemesi.
exampleSentences: The convergence of telecommunications and computing created entirely new industries.
Analysts point to a growing convergence between television and internet services.
The convergence of several technologies made the smartphone possible.

items.definition: Değişen koşullara göre kendini ayarlayabilen veya uyum sağlayabilen.
exampleSentences: The software uses an adaptive algorithm that adjusts to each user's habits.
Adaptive lighting systems change brightness depending on the time of day.
The course uses adaptive testing to match questions to the student's level.

items.definition: Yapısı veya işleyişi karmaşık ve gelişmiş düzeyde olan.
exampleSentences: The company developed a more sophisticated system to detect fraud.
Modern smartphones contain increasingly sophisticated cameras.
Hackers are using more sophisticated methods to bypass security systems.

items.definition: Daha önce hiç görülmemiş veya yaşanmamış, benzeri olmayan.
exampleSentences: The technology sector has grown at an unprecedented rate over the past decade.
The company faced unprecedented demand for its new product.
Access to data on this scale is entirely unprecedented.

items.definition: Aksama veya kesinti olmadan, kusursuzca akıcı biçimde gerçekleşen.
exampleSentences: The update was designed to give users a seamless transition between devices.
Good design creates a seamless experience for the customer.
Engineers aimed for a seamless integration of the two systems.

items.definition: Bir alanda düşünme ve uygulama biçimini belirleyen temel model veya çerçeve.
exampleSentences: The internet created an entirely new paradigm for how businesses reach customers.
Researchers argue that artificial intelligence represents a paradigm shift in computing.
The old paradigm of centralised computing has largely given way to cloud services.

items.definition: Bir şeyin, özellikle hızlı biçimde, sayıca artıp yaygınlaşması.
exampleSentences: The proliferation of smartphones has changed how people access information.
Regulators are concerned about the proliferation of unverified data online.
The rapid proliferation of connected devices has raised new security risks.

items.definition: Bir sistemin işlemesi için gerekli temel yapılar, tesisler ve ağların bütünü.
exampleSentences: The city needs to invest more in its digital infrastructure.
Poor infrastructure was blamed for the repeated power outages.
Building reliable infrastructure is essential for expanding internet access.

items.definition: Bir şeyi, genellikle ustalıkla veya gizlice, istenen sonucu elde etmek için kontrol edip yönlendirmek.
exampleSentences: The software allows designers to manipulate images with great precision.
Investigators found evidence that the data had been manipulated.
Engineers can manipulate the robot's arm remotely using a simple controller.

items.definition: Bir kişi, alan veya faaliyetin sürekli olarak gözetim altında tutulması.
exampleSentences: The building is monitored by a network of surveillance cameras.
Critics argue that mass surveillance threatens individual privacy.
Police increased surveillance in the area after several break-ins.

items.definition: Kimliği bilinmeyen veya açıklanmayan.
exampleSentences: Users can leave anonymous comments on the forum without creating an account.
An anonymous donor funded the entire research project.
The survey guarantees that all responses remain anonymous.

items.definition: Bir şeyi çok dikkatli ve ayrıntılı biçimde inceleyip değerlendirmek.
exampleSentences: Regulators scrutinised the company's data practices after the complaints.
Journalists scrutinised the algorithm to see how it made its decisions.
Every line of code was scrutinised before the software went live.

items.definition: Bir kaynağı veya avantajı, daha büyük bir sonuç elde etmek için etkili biçimde kullanmak.
exampleSentences: The start-up leveraged its existing user base to launch the new product.
Companies increasingly leverage data to personalise their marketing.
The team leveraged cloud computing to scale the service quickly.

items.definition: Bir şeyin zaman içinde izlediği gelişim yönü veya seyir.
exampleSentences: The company's growth trajectory has been remarkable since it adopted new technology.
Analysts are trying to predict the trajectory of artificial intelligence research.
The project's trajectory changed sharply after the unexpected breakthrough.

items.definition: Bir şeyi daha büyük bir bütünün parçası hâline getirerek dahil etmek.
exampleSentences: The new model incorporates several features requested by users.
Designers incorporated feedback from the pilot study into the final version.
The company plans to incorporate artificial intelligence into its next product line.
